user.description: Play Hue dynamic scenes on Hue lamps paired to ZHA. Zones and palettes are set up in the options afterwards.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only a single configuration possible.
abort.zha_not_ready: ZHA is not running. Set up ZHA first.

menu_options.import_hue: Import palettes from a Hue bridge

import_hue.title: Import from a Hue bridge
import_hue.description: Reads the dynamic scenes of the bridge. Nothing is changed on the bridge. Import before moving lamps to ZHA: the per-lamp start colours come along.

data_description.hue_host: Host name or IP address of the bridge.
data_description.hue_app_key: A CLIP v2 application key of the bridge, for example the one the Hue integration uses.

data_description.colors: 2 to 9 colours as hex RGB, separated by commas, for example #ff8800, #ffd000, #00a0ff.
data_description.speed: How fast the lamps move through the colours. Hue scenes use about 0.63.

data_description.colors: 2 to 9 colours as hex RGB, separated by commas, for example #ff8800, #ffd000, #00a0ff.
data_description.speed: How fast the lamps move through the colours. Hue scenes use about 0.63.

add_zone.title: Add a zone
add_zone.description: A zone is a ZHA group. Its lamps start a palette together.

zone.title: Zone {zone}
zone.description:
Clusters (lamps that start with the same colour):
{clusters}

data_description.automatic: Offer the imported palettes of the Hue room or zone with the same lamps, and all custom palettes.

add_cluster.title: Add a cluster
add_cluster.description: Lamps in a cluster start with the same colour and stay in sync, for example a pair of lamps on both sides of a door.

error.invalid_auth: The bridge rejected the application key.
error.invalid_colors: Enter 2 to 9 colours as hex RGB, for example #ff8800.
error.cluster_too_small: A cluster needs at least two lights.

abort.no_groups: There are no ZHA groups with lights left to add.

send_failed.message: Could not start the dynamic scene: {error}

activate.name: Activate
activate.description: Starts the palette of a scene on its zone, optionally with another speed, brightness or transition.

speed.name: Speed
speed.description: Animation speed from 0 to 1 instead of the palette's.

brightness.name: Brightness
brightness.description: Brightness from 1 to 255 for all lamps instead of the palette's.

transition.name: Transition
transition.description: Duration of the transition to the start colours.

rewrite_scenes.name: Rewrite scenes
rewrite_scenes.description: Writes the zone's palettes to the lamps again, each on its next activation. Use it when scenes were removed from the lamps by other means.
